title: 第九章 凌波微步北蛮落网第十章 收获香菱天元赌坊
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 贾环眼前一亮，这倒是有几分类似了。
“这种可能还是有的，如果是他国奸细的话，这就能解释得通了。”
贾环手指敲打着桌面，他们已经有好些日子没开张了。
自上次抓了飞天狐，这小花枝巷就像变安分了一样。
贼人都不往这里来！
现在有几分怀疑，就可以动手。
而且还很有可能抓到奸细！
“干，马上准备，就在我们快要下值的时候!”
贾环立即让马癞先去做好准备。
马癞先过去打头站，他们三人在小花枝巷在等会。
傍晚时分，等那一会人都到院子的时候，再一网打尽。
日落时分。
薛蟠正带着几个手下去往小花枝巷。
正好就见到贾环远远离开。
薛蟠摸了摸下巴，这贾环现在是总旗了，也不知道具体做些什么，跟上去，说不定能看到一些。
“你们两个，跟上，不要让环小子发现，看他到底去做些什么勾当！”
薛蟠带着人在后面跟了上去。
贾环为了不引起那宅邸里的人注意。
装成若无其事的巡逻着街道。
一路朝着指引的方向而去。
马癞已来汇报，那伙人已经回去了，一共有五个人，都是孔武有力的大汉。
贾环让他们三人把武器准备好。
“周旭，你至少要压制一个，霍老和马癞你们两人合力对付一个，剩下的三个交给我。”
贾环有凌波微步傍身，这才有信心拿下五人！
几人到了小院附近，此刻这院子大门紧锁，想要破门反而容易惊动里面的人。
“直接跃墙进去，记住，要是遇到反抗，直接动手，要是束手就擒，就不要伤人。”
若是有反抗，说明不会冤枉他们。
普通百姓遇到士兵，基本都不敢反抗。
“是！”周旭等人回应。
找了个可以借力的地方，贾环和周旭两人率先跳进去。
content_en:
"Huh?"
Jia Huan's eyes lit up, this was somewhat similar.
"This possibility is still possible. If it is a spy from another country, this would make sense."
Jia Huan tapped his fingers on the table. They had not been open for several days.
Since the flying fox was caught last time, Xiaohuazhi Lane seems to have become more peaceful.
No thieves come here!
Now that you have some doubts, you can take action.
And it’s very possible to catch the spy!
"Go ahead, get ready now, just when we're about to leave!"
Jia Huan immediately asked Ma Lei to get ready first.
Ma Lei went over first and took the lead, while the three of them were waiting in Xiaohuazhi Lane.
In the evening, when everyone comes to the yard, catch them all.
…
At sunset.
Xue Pan was heading to Xiaohuazhi Lane with a few of his men.
Just in time to see Jia Huan leaving far away.
Xue Pan touched his chin. Jia Huan was now the commander-in-chief, and he didn't know what he was going to do. If he followed him, he might be able to see something.
"You two, follow up, don't let Boy Huan find out, let's see what he is doing!"
Xue Pan followed with his people.
…
Jia Huan wanted to avoid attracting the attention of the people in the mansion.
Pretending to be nonchalant, he patrolled the streets.
Go all the way in the direction shown.
Ma Lei has come to report that the group has gone back. There are five people in total, all of them are powerful men.
Jia Huan asked the three of them to prepare their weapons.
"Zhou Xu, you have to suppress at least one. Huo Lao and Ma Lei, you two work together to deal with one, and leave the remaining three to me."
Jia Huan had Ling Bo walking beside him, so he was confident that he could win five people!
Several people arrived near the small courtyard. The door of the courtyard was locked at the moment. If they wanted to break the door, they would easily disturb the people inside.
"Just jump over the wall and go in. Remember, if you encounter resistance, just take action. If you are defeated, don't hurt anyone."
If there is resistance, it means that they will not be wronged.
Ordinary people basically dare not resist when they encounter soldiers.
"Yes!" Zhou Xu and others responded.
Finding a place where they could borrow strength, Jia Huan and Zhou Xu jumped in first.
